description: This file defines a React component for a user profile and skills page, including state management, form validation, data loading/saving from/to Supabase, and UI interactions for profile editing, skills, education, resume, and preferences.

methods.name: validateProfile
methods.description: Validates profile form fields such as full name, email, phone, location, and bio, returning error messages for invalid inputs.

methods.name: validateResume
methods.description: Validates resume file name and link fields, ensuring they meet length and URL format requirements.

methods.name: validateNewSkill
methods.description: Validates a new skill input for presence, length, uniqueness, and allowed characters.

methods.name: validateCareerPreferences
methods.description: Validates career preference fields such as location, role, salary, shift, job type, and employment type.

methods.name: validateEducation
methods.description: Validates education details for 10th, 12th, and graduation fields.

methods.name: validateProject
methods.description: Validates project title and description fields.

methods.name: validateLanguages
methods.description: Validates the languages input as a comma-separated list with length and character restrictions.

methods.name: updateProfileField
methods.description: Updates a profile field and performs live validation.

methods.name: updateCareerPrefField
methods.description: Updates a career preference field and performs live validation.

methods.name: updateEducationField
methods.description: Updates an education field and performs live validation.

methods.name: updateProjectField
methods.description: Updates a project field and performs live validation.

methods.name: addSkillDraft
methods.description: Adds a new skill to the skills draft list after validation.

methods.name: removeSkillDraft
methods.description: Removes a skill from the draft list by name.

methods.name: saveSkills
methods.description: Syncs skills draft with global state and persists to Supabase.

methods.name: resetSkills
methods.description: Resets skills draft to current global state.

methods.name: persistToSupabaseBestEffort
methods.description: Attempts to save profile and skills to Supabase without blocking UI, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: saveResume
methods.description: Uploads or replaces resume file, updates profile, and persists changes.

methods.name: resetResume
methods.description: Resets resume file selection.

methods.name: deleteResume
methods.description: Deletes resume from storage and updates profile.

methods.name: saveProfile
methods.description: Validates and saves profile data, updates cloud via API calls, and syncs with AppState.

methods.name: resetProfile
methods.description: Resets profile draft to current state.

methods.name: saveCareerPreferences
methods.description: Validates and saves career preferences, updating profile and cloud.

methods.name: resetCareerPreferences
methods.description: Resets career preferences to current profile data.

methods.name: saveEducation
methods.description: Validates and saves education details, updating profile and cloud.

methods.name: resetEducation
methods.description: Resets education draft to current profile data.
